reasoning: On the season so far the Bulls are the stronger team; with home court the Bulls start about 1 points better, in a game of about 238 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Bulls win 53 times in 100; most games like this end between 213 and 261 total points.
